
  Keyboard shortcuts

  Compose
  !                     Shell Mode
  ctrl+j                New line
  / / @ / $             Pick command / …
  arrows                Move caret / in…
  ctrl+← / ctrl+→       Previous / next…
  alt/option+← / →      Previous / next…
  ctrl+↑ / ctrl+↓       Start / end of …
  alt/option+backspace  Delete previous…
  ctrl+w / alt+del      Delete previous…
  ctrl+k                Delete to end o…
  ctrl+z / ctrl+y       Undo / redo
  ctrl+v                Paste image
  ctrl+g                External editor
  Session
  enter                 Send / steer
  tab                   Queue for next …
  alt+↑ / shift+←       Edit last queued
  shift+↑ / shift+↓     Raise / lower r…
  /status /session      Settings / laun…
  /ps                   Running process…
  /copy                 Copy response o…
  /btw QUESTION         Side question /…
  /model /effort /tier  Open picker or …
  ctrl+c                Clear / interru…
  esc                   Interrupt, keep…
  ctrl+b 1–3            Main / toggle D…
  ctrl+b e / r          Pin next live e…
  ctrl+b q              Approvals, then…
  ctrl+b !              Error details
  ctrl+b p              Presets
  ctrl+b ← / →          Resize panes
  Transcript
  ctrl+e       Default / events / all
  pgup / pgdn  Scroll
  esc          Back to bottom
  ? / esc  Close shortcuts
